findings.text: The frame requirement assumes that an unnamed table keeps its rows, but `RebuildRuns.unsafe_rebuild_cascades` shows DROP TABLE changing an unnamed child through a foreign-key cascade. Fix: require an explicit condition excluding indirect effects on the observed table, such as disabled foreign-key enforcement.

The listed INSERT SELECT success constraints omit STRICT column types, which `LiteralData.upsertRow` checks through `typesFit` and can reject even when every listed constraint holds. Fix: include type compatibility after affinity conversion and a failing STRICT-type example.
